summary: Build and test infrastructure for the @barkpark/core JS SDK — packages the client for CJS/ESM/TypeScript consumers and validates it across Node, browser, and Cloudflare Workers runtimes, plus a live regression harness against prod.

intentions.title: Ship a universal JS SDK that runs anywhere
intentions.evidence: tsup.config.ts emits both CJS (.cjs) and ESM (.mjs) with tree-shaking + dts; separate vitest configs for node, browser (Playwright/Chromium), and Cloudflare Workers (workerd) prove the same package works across all three runtimes

intentions.title: Prevent API contract regressions from shipping to consumers
intentions.evidence: scripts/live-regression.mjs imports the built dist and fires real requests at prod (89.167.28.206) to prove defects #16 (docs.find() envelope) and #18 (single-doc fetch) stay fixed; fails with non-zero exit on shape mismatch

intentions.title: Maintain tight TypeScript DX for SDK consumers
intentions.evidence: tsup.config.ts sets dts:true and sourcemap:true, targeting es2022 with code-splitting — consumers get full types, source maps, and shake-friendly imports out of the box
